newsitem.title: EGYPT: Abu Qir half-yr profit up 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Abu Qir half-yr profit up 30 pct.

text.p: Abu Qir Fertiliser and Chemical Industries said on Tuesday it made net after-tax profits of 117 million pounds ($34.5 million) in the first half of the financial year 1996/7, 30 percent up on 90 million in the same period of the previous year. The years start July 1.
Sales in the six-month period were worth 301.920 million pounds, 15.8 per cent up on 260.711 million.

At the end of the period, on December 31, shareholders funds were worth 803 million, equivalent to 21.26 pounds for each of the 37,767,240 shares. The shares closed at 104.00 pounds on the Egyptian stock exchange on Monday.
